text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — The exact match. EAU evaluates its training framework on UserGym and ColBench. Authors: Min Cai (University of Alberta), Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore), Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology), Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher), and Xi Ye (University of Alberta; Amii). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **UserRL: Training Interactive User-Centric Agent via Reinforcement Learning** — Introduces the standardized gym environments referred to as UserGym. Authors: Cheng Qian and Heng Ji (University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign); Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Jielin Qiu, Zhiwei Liu, Haolin Chen, Shirley Kokane, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang (Salesforce AI Research). [Project page](https://lifelongagent.github.io/Project-Lifelong-Agent/UserRL/index.html)

3. **SWEET-RL: Training Multi-Turn LLM Agents on Collaborative Reasoning Tasks** — Introduces ColBench, covering collaborative backend-programming and frontend-design tasks. Authors: Yifei Zhou, Song Jiang, Yuandong Tian, Jason Weston, Sergey Levine, Sainbayar Sukhbaatar, and Xian Li; affiliations are UC Berkeley and Meta FAIR. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15478)

4. **InfoPO: Information-Driven Policy Optimization for User-Centric Agents** — Closely related work evaluated on both UserGym and ColBench, alongside τ²-Bench. Authors: Fanqi Kong, Jiayi Zhang, Mingyi Deng, Chenglin Wu, Yuyu Luo, and Bang Liu; affiliated collectively with Peking University, DeepWisdom, HKUST (Guangzhou), Université de Montréal, and Mila. [ICML/PMLR](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v306/kong26g.html)

query: EAU project website environment agent user co-evolution
text:
1. [Official EAU project website](https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/) — Interactive overview of the framework, method, and results. People: Min Cai (University of Alberta), Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore), Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology), Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher), and Xi Ye (University of Alberta and Amii). Cai and Zhang are equal contributors.

2. [EAU paper on arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523) — Primary preprint, submitted October 12, 2026: “EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents.” Same authors and affiliations as above. It reports up to a 36.7% relative improvement in ColBench task completion.

3. [Min Cai’s research page](https://henrycai11.github.io/) — Lead author’s page describing EAU as a meta-agent framework for co-evolving agents and their learning environments. Cai is a PhD researcher at the University of Alberta, advised by coauthor Xi Ye.

query: framework jointly adapts simulated user environment rewards RL configuration
text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — The closest match. Its framework jointly adapts the user simulator, environment, reward design, and RL configuration during training.  
   **People:** Min Cai (University of Alberta), Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore), Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology), Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher), Xi Ye (University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute).  
   **URL:** [arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **UserRL: Training Interactive User-Centric Agent via Reinforcement Learning** — A unified framework combining simulated users, standardized interactive environments, configurable turn-level rewards, and trajectory scoring under GRPO.  
   **People:** Cheng Qian (Salesforce AI Research and UIUC), Heng Ji (UIUC); Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Jielin Qiu, Zhiwei Liu, Haolin Chen, Shirley Kokane, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang (Salesforce AI Research).  
   **URL:** [arxiv.org/abs/2509.19736](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19736)

3. **Jointly Reinforced User Simulator and Task-oriented Dialog System with Simplified Generative Architecture** — Earlier work that jointly optimizes a dialogue agent and its simulated user through online RL.  
   **People:** Hong Liu and Zhijian Ou (Tsinghua University); Yi Huang and Junlan Feng (China Mobile Research Institute), associated through the Tsinghua–China Mobile Joint Institute.  
   **URL:** [arxiv.org/abs/2210.06706](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.06706)
